description: methodology 1.5 — the rating-orthogonality penalty: the shipped per-tail form against the whole-axis form, against the penalty removed, against a free control carrying neither the penalty nor the teaching pull. The claims: a whole-axis penalty is a LINEAR statistic and cannot see a symmetric tail dependence, so that arm reports small whole-axis correlations while its axis ENDS — the only part a name is read off — stay rating-laden several-fold higher; scoring the two ends separately cuts the worst end to a fraction of that; with the penalty off the axes absorb the shipped per-problem quantities; and the free control spends an axis on a shipped parameter outright, the doc's signature being its correlation with SLOPE rather than with difficulty.
